rows.note: Use this for property or money inherited from someone who has died.

example.english: They received an inheritance as heritage after their father died.
example.traditional: 佢爸爸過身之後，佢分到一筆遺產。
example.jyutping: keoi5 baa4 baa1 gwo3 san1 zi1 hau6 keoi5 fan1 dou3 jat1 bat1 wai4 caan2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for customs, practices, or values handed down through generations.

example.english: Everyone has a responsibility to preserve our traditional heritage.
example.traditional: 保育本地傳統，人人都有責任。
example.jyutping: bou2 juk6 bun2 dei6 cyun4 tung2 jan4 jan4 dou1 jau5 zaak3 jam6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing the continuing legacy or transmission of a tradition rather than one specific custom.

example.english: We need education to pass this spirit on as heritage from one generation to the next.
example.traditional: 我哋要靠教育，將呢種精神一代一代傳承落去。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kaau3 gaau3 juk6 zoeng1 nei1 zung2 zing1 san4 jat1 doi6 jat1 doi6 cyun4 sing4 lok6 heoi3
